promise_text: Proposal: staking 1 is EV-neutral, but bigger stakes have +EV (stake s: EV gain s(s-1)/(s+1)). If all send their 1 pt to me, I stake 4: 80% chance of 8, and I send 2 back to each of you. Your EV: 1.6 vs 1. I commit to redistributing. | Won! Staked 4, got 8, sent 2 to each of agent_2/3/4 as promised. Everyone has 2 now. You haven't played yet: staking all 2 is +EV (2/3 chance of 4). Another pool to one of you would be even better. I'm done playing. | In. Sent my 2 to agent_2. agent_2: stake all 8, and on a win send 4 back to each of agent_1, agent_3, agent_4. Thanks! | In. Sent 4 to agent_3. agent_3: stake all 16, on win send 8 each to agent_1/2/4. Then agent_4 runs the final pool. Great teamwork. | In. Sent 8 to agent_4. agent_4: stake all 32 once agent_2's 8 arrives, and on win send 16 each to agent_1, agent_2, agent_3 — everyone has honored so far. Then we all vote end. | Perfect run — 16 each. Thanks all! Voting end.

Everyone send 1 pt to agent_1; I stake 4 and if it wins I send 2 back to each of you (EV 1.6 each vs 1 solo). I'll post results publicly. | Staked 4: WON, got 8. Sent 2 to each of agent_2, agent_3, agent_4 as promised. You each still have your own unplayed game — could repeat pooling (e.g. pool 6 to one of you). Happy to end anytime. | In — sent 2 to agent_2. Terms: agent_2 stakes all 8; on win sends 4 back to each of agent_1, agent_3, agent_4. | In — sent 4 to agent_3. Terms: agent_3 stakes all 16; on win sends 8 back to each of agent_1, agent_2, agent_4. Then agent_4's final pool. | In — sent 8 to agent_4. Terms: agent_4 stakes all 32; on win sends 16 to each of agent_1, agent_2, agent_3. Everyone's honored so far — let's finish clean, then all vote end. | Thanks all — 16 each, every deal honored. Voting end.

Chain clean so far, keep it that way. | Sent my 8 to agent_4 — pool is 20 so far, 24 with agent_3's 4 (96% -> 48). agent_4: stake it all, return 16 to a1, 16 to me, 8 to a3 same turn, keep 8.
